title: NABARD Student Internship Scheme 2027
summary: 8–12 week study projects on agriculture, rural finance and development with NABARD regional offices.
eligibility: PG students (MBA/PGDM, agriculture and allied, economics, social sciences, management) at reputed Indian institutions.

prize.description: ₹18,000–20,000 per month in recent cycles, plus travel support for field visits.

notes: Applications usually open in February–March; the 2026–27 scheme had about 39 seats.
